title: Training Notes: Wayfare Pro Status and the Lapse Allowance of a Driver's Document Hold
content:
These training notes concern **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** agreements placed on a document hold, and the lapse allowance days of that hold: the calendar days the hold may run from its hold start date before it ends in deactivation for document lapse. The Wayfare Pro status that bears on them is the status held on the driver's earnings account under the **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** product.

**Rule.** A driver whose earnings account holds Wayfare Pro Gold, Wayfare Pro Platinum, Wayfare Pro Diamond or Wayfare Pro Diamond Elite adds 10 days to the lapse allowance days; a driver holding Wayfare Pro Silver adds 5 days; a driver holding Wayfare Pro Blue adds none.

| Wayfare Pro status on the earnings account | Days added |
|---|---|
| Wayfare Pro Diamond Elite | 10 |
| Wayfare Pro Diamond | 10 |
| Wayfare Pro Platinum | 10 |
| Wayfare Pro Gold | 10 |
| Wayfare Pro Silver | 5 |
| Wayfare Pro Blue | 0 |

### Questions answered

**Where is the status read?** On the driver's earnings account (Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro), as the Pro status that account holds; the driver agreement itself does not carry it.

**Does a higher status than Gold add more than 10 days?** No. Gold, Platinum, Diamond and Diamond Elite all add 10 days.

**What does a Silver driver receive?** 5 days. A Blue driver receives none.

**Hypothetical example.** A driver whose earnings account holds Wayfare Pro Platinum has 10 days added to the lapse allowance days of a document hold on that driver's agreement.
